body:
Bump every @adlc publish target from 1.11.1 to 1.12.0 in lockstep, curate the CHANGELOG entry for the release, land it via PR, tag v1.12.0, and shepherd the gated npm publish.

The full release audit returned GO-WITH-RISK (0 blockers, 84 should-fix, 75 backlog, all 370 open issues triaged) after the two blockers were fixed in #1189. Two package names are new to npm in this release, @adlc/backlog-groom and @adlc/decision-layer, so each needs a one-time manual bootstrap publish before the tag (release profile, v1.11.1 incident).

The bump is mechanical and produced by scripts/release.mjs; no manifest is hand-edited. One test is changed: scripts/test/docs-release-claims.test.mjs asserted that [Unreleased] holds the breaking changes since 1.11.1, which no release tree can satisfy; it now checks everything above the [1.11.1] heading. Because a lockstep bump touches every packages/** and plugins/** manifest plus package.json and package-lock.json, it lands in TRUST-ROOT tier and requires a signed distinct-provider cross-model attestation. This ticket exists so that attestation binds to a work item that describes the release, per the 1.11.0 and 1.11.1 precedent (T-01M0TC5BP3PRR08TP38FP8PV6C, T-01M1RQEGRPA6CR41D73Y8QZ2DF).

Acceptance criteria:

1. Every non-private publish target under packages/* and plugins/*, the root manifest, the marketplace manifests, and package-lock.json read 1.12.0.
   Verify: for f in package.json $(find packages plugins -maxdepth 2 -name package.json -not -path '*/node_modules/*'); do node -p "require('./'+'$f').version"; done | sort -u  -- must print exactly 1.12.0.

2. packages/core/package.json (the profile's versionSource) reads exactly 1.12.0, so the tag matches the version source.
   Verify: [ "$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")" = "1.12.0" ]

3. The full test suite passes on the exact tree that gets tagged, after the bump and changelog edits.
   Verify: npm test  -- must exit 0 and report all segments green.

4. CHANGELOG.md carries a [1.12.0] section and [Unreleased] sits above it.
   Verify: grep -n '^## \[' CHANGELOG.md | head -2  -- must show [Unreleased] on the earlier line and [1.12.0] on the later.

5. The releaseNotes extraction for 1.12.0 is non-empty, so the GitHub Release body mirrors the changelog.
   Verify: [ -n "$(awk '/^## \[1.12.0\]/{f=1;next} /^## \[/{f=0} f' CHANGELOG.md)" ]

6. Every non-private publish target exists on npm at 1.12.0 with dist-tag latest pointing at it.
   Verify: the release profile's verify block, which enumerates targets from the filesystem and fails closed.
title: Cut the 1.12.0 lockstep minor release of the @adlc suite
